$Comment: Effect Wand: the wand's usual poses (Parent Wand) plus EffectCast (right click), a copy of the vanilla Wand CastLeft (Cast_Left*.blockyanim) to edit in Blockbench: Common/Characters/Animations/Items/MobBattle/EffectCast/. EffectSlam (right click, 2026-10-13): the Snap Wand's SnapSlam (and the mace Swing_Down_FPS in first person) plus one full turn of the gem head (bone15) around the hit; a player animation can key the held item's own nodes (vanilla bows key Bow-Top-Pulley, flails Chain). EffectSpin (right click): EffectCast plus one full turn of the gem head; EffectSlam is now the held left click's (2026-10-13). EffectCharge (held left while charging, 2026-10-13, playtest): the vanilla Wand Cast_Left_Charging with the gem spinning 5 turns per loop; EffectSlam carries the spin on, 3 turns slowing down (scratch charge.py).
